claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns Q with e(P,Q)=z for the supplied nonidentity P with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, under heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT, at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64)(2^114.008895466+2^66) < 2^112.650920549369 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000): an expectation over the challenge and the coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every run. A run gate (u < K = 7196619466409573109, (K/2^64) x 0.999668 >= 0.39) precedes an opened run that succeeds with probability at least 0.999668 and costs at most 2^125.000686637801 units. Nothing is amortized. Analytic exploratory claim.
